evidence.quote: Fund sandbox 'apollo' (2026-10-06), 2024-03-31: 'Insurance First Lien Secured Debt - Revolver' carries fair value 50,488,000 and cost 50,312,000 with no issuer, principal, rate or maturity. Published total 8,525.1M against filed investments 8,474.7M (no cash equivalents that quarter): excess 50.5M, equal to this row.
Across 2023-03-31 to 2026-03-31 it is the only Apollo row above 1M with a fair value and no principal, units or maturity outside the cash class.

rationale: An industry-and-instrument heading with a value and no issuer is a subtotal, not a position. Every Apollo position names its issuer before the words Investment Type (or Security Type) and ends with a rate and maturity. The rule is structural: it keys on the missing issuer part and the missing principal, units and maturity, not on a filing's row ids, so it applies to every quarter. Authored in an interactive session and checked by fund-sandbox reconciliation, not by the fleet promotion gate.
